st.t: 80th Birthday Celebration of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, 4 Dec 2000
w: The 5-day festival climaxed with Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 80th Birthday Celebration. The morning puja of Swamishri was performed amidst a devotionally-charged assembly of devotees. The bhajans by sadhus and an array of birthday cards and decorations added to the celebratory mood of the festival.

The evening program depicted the theme, 'Gurur Brahma, Gurur Vishnu, Gurur Devo Maheshwara ...' which eloborated upon the Guru as being the creator (of an ethico-spiritual society), the sustainer (of virtues) and the destroyer (of vices and addictions).

The tempo of the festival was set rolling with a colorful procession with Swamishri seated on a decorated float. Several skits, video projections and narrations of extraordinary devotees, folk-dances, devotional bhajans and discourses enlightened the mammoth assembly. The evening celebration was set ablaze by a sea of divas - arti performed by 300,000 devotees.

Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, saying: "I offer my humble Jai Swaminarayan to the sadhus and to all the devotees who have come from far and wide, bearing discomforts on your way here. "Bhagwan Swaminarayan has said, 'Without my wish even a dry leaf cannot be plucked.' However out of arrogance we feel that 'I have done it.' But we are incapable of doing anything. "Once Maharaj left alone for Visnagar to transform the Suba (ruler) who persecuted His devotees. When Mulji Brahmachari told the Lord to turn back Maharaj questioned him, 'What do you believe me as?' 'The supreme Lord,' replied the Brahmachari. 'Tell me, who moves the leaves and the trees?' Maharaj asked. 'The wind,' the Brahmachari answered naively. 'But who moves the wind?' Maharaj questioned. "At this question the Brahmachari realised and said, 'You!' 'Then in whose hand lies the life of the Suba!' Maharaj asked and then added, 'What can the Suba do to me?' "So it is due to God's wish and power that everything happens. Because of man's own arrogance he experiences conflict and unrest. This is why Bhagwan Swaminarayan has emphasised one to pray, 'O God. Protect me from the maya of 'I-ness' and 'Mine-ness.' The root of all conflicts and misery is 'I' and 'Mine.' But who is 'I' in this body? We have falsely accepted that I belong to this caste and this is my status... but this is ignorance. "If one realises the true knowledge of one's form then one would be redeemed from ignorance. Because King Parikshit was not welcomed in a Rishi's ashram, he placed a dead snake around the Rishi's neck. The Rishi's son cursed the King with death in seven days. The king then went to Shukdevji, who imparted to him the knowledge of atma. And Parikshit was redeemed by listening to the discourses of Shukdevji.... "A Gunatit Guru blesses us with the true knowledge of atma and makes us eternally happy."
After his morning puja, Swamishri performed pujan of bricks for the foundation of a Hari mandir in the village of Shela.

At 11.00 am Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir for the villages of Gamdi, Vaghasi and Parth Township (Jhol). Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly.
At 11.00 children brought a variety of food items to offer as annakut to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. They all gathered and sang thals.

At 7.00 pm the Children’s Day program included prayers, monoacting of Premji Variya and a quiz, ‘Kon Banega Adarsh Balak’. The assembly was capped with Swamishri’s blessings, “The children played a good quiz themed ‘Who will become an ideal child’. Normally one thinks about becoming a millionaire, a president, etc. To become ideal one must have knowledge of our Sampraday, and know of the life and work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. One reads the Shikshapatri but who wrote it and where was it written? One must know who and where the Bhagwat and Gita were written…”

Russi Mody, once CEO of Tata Steel and formerly also head of Indian Airlines and Air India, came for darshan. With him was Shri Aditya Kashyap, chairman of the IIM management institute in Kolkata. Russi Mody is 88 years old, a jovial Parsi gentleman. He came before Pramukh Swami Maharaj and sat on a chair. He had learnt about Akshardham. The cheerful Parsi gentleman asked Swamishri, "Where is your permanent home?"
"The whole world." Saying this, Swamishri raised his hand and made circles in the air with the first finger of his right hand.
"So you have no home at all, is that it? Very good... very good... no worries about any home." The Parsi gentleman laughed freely.
Laughing, Swamishri said, "Wherever we go is home." Swamishri said this with complete detachment. The whole earth is indeed his home! For Swamishri is a world figure.
"Which school did you go to study at?" Russi Mody asked.
"A Gujarati school," Swamishri told him with great openness.
"Do you like Kolkata?"
"There are devotees, so I like it." Swamishri revealed the real secret.

Swamishri was feeling fine today after having chest pain a few days ago. However, doctors advised him that he should have a check-up in Mumbai.

At 4.00 p.m. Swamishri departed from Bochasan and arrived at Harni Airport in Vadodara at 4.50 p.m. The flight landed at 6.30 p.m. On arriving at the mandir in Dadar thousands of devotees welcomed Swamishri. After Thakorji’s darshan, Swamishri went to the Nilkanth Abhishek Mandapam for darshan. Thereafter Swamishri inaugurated the newly built ‘Pramukhsadan’ by untying the nadachhadi amidst Vedic chantings. After having dinner Swamishri was checked by Dr Ashwinbhai Mehta, a renowned cardiologist. Dr Mehta told Swamishri and the sadhus that there was nothing to be worried about.

In the morning Pramukh Swami Maharaj came for darshan of Thakorji. After darshan he came to Bhagatji Maharaj's shrine on the circumambulation path. Meanwhile Swamishri had spotted from afar Akhand, the son of Jayendrabhai, son of Arunbhai Patel of Anand. Swamishri had been told last night that Akhand could not see with one eye. So he at once said, "Bring that boy here."
Akhand was brought before Swamishri. Swamishri passed his hand over his eye and said, "Keep doing the exercises as the doctor says, and it will get better; and turn the mala every day and pray."
How Swamishri remembered even the difficulties of a small child and cared about them!

On the doctors' advice, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was going to Mumbai precisely for a health check. According to the earlier planned programme, the 10th anniversary celebration of the Anand mandir was going on just now, and Swamishri was to stay in Anand for about 13 days, but now that he had to go to Mumbai, the sadhus of Anand came here for Swamishri's darshan.

During the meal Sarvamangal Swami said to Swamishri, "When I spoke here of the Anand 10th anniversary festival at the time of the head shaving, you said on hearing it that the 10th anniversary festival had been celebrated! At that time we did not know that you were speaking prophetic words."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to go from Bochasan to Vadodara and from there by plane to Mumbai. At 4.50 they reached Harni Airport, Vadodara. The whole Vadodara satsang mandal had gathered to have darshan of Swamishri as he passed. Permission had been given for Swamishri's car. Senior airport officials welcomed Swamishri, and the car was taken right up to the plane.

After all preparations had been made inside, Swamishri boarded the plane. With Swamishri were Viveksagar Swami, Yogicharan Swami, Krishnavallabh Swami and Narayancharan Swami, and Dr Kiranbhai Doshi was also with them. Exactly at the scheduled time of 5.10, the plane set off towards Mumbai. If all went smoothly, they were to reach Mumbai in just 34 minutes. Swamishri was coming for a health check, but he was in such a light hearted mood and laughed so much even at small things that no one with him felt any sense of the seriousness of his health.

After a while Dr Kiranbhai Doshi checked Swamishri's pulse. The pulse was normal. In a light mood, Swamishri said, laughing, "He just checked the pulse. We wouldn't even know. Only when the doctor says it is the heart do we know; otherwise we know nothing. How many people in the world must be just carrying on! The doctor keeps going up and down, up and down."
Hearing this, the sadhus said, "You are the life breath of the whole satsang. So even if you have a little something, it affects the whole satsang."

Thus light conversation went on. Everyone thought, "Mumbai will come any moment," but the Mumbai airstrip was busy. So the plane had to circle around Mumbai. For a long time the plane's screen kept displaying that it would take 27 minutes to reach Mumbai. At most it would come down to 23 or 24 minutes and then go back up to 27 minutes. So it felt as if they had gone only a little way from Vadodara. It was a wonderful sight, as if gliding through a sheet of thick clouds. The sun too was about to set, and because of it the golden lines formed on the edges of the clouds on the horizon looked extremely enchanting. Swamishri too looked at this edge. There is a saying about a silver lining, but this was a wonderful sight as if gold were raining down!

The plane must have circled around Mumbai for about half an hour, and that is why Swamishri kept looking at the screen again and again. In Swamishri's mind there was only one remedy for getting permission to land: dhun. And so, looking at Harikrishna Maharaj, Swamishri began a dhun, and as if a miracle had happened, the plane began to descend. Only when the plane touched the airstrip did Swamishri finish the dhun.

It was 6.30. Darkness had fallen. The plane came to a halt. Swamishri came down by forklift and sat in the car. Then Kothari Swami welcomed Swamishri with a bouquet. The airport officials also received Swamishri's blessings, and after that the car left the airport. Here the escort youths did fine seva in bringing Swamishri to Dadar very quickly through the heavy evening traffic.
After coming to Mumbai, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was coming to his newly built residence for the first time. Swamishri's residence was on the thirteenth floor.

At 9.40 at night the renowned cardiologist Dr Ashwinbhai B. Mehta came to examine Swamishri. He was in Kolkata and had taken an early flight just to examine Swamishri. Today he had something like diarrhoea, yet ignoring it, he had come especially for Swamishri. After hearing the whole sequence of events from Swamishri, Swamishri was laid on the bed, and after doing all the checks, he went outside, consulted a little, then came back to Swamishri and said, "There is nothing worrying. Tomorrow we will do a few tests, and then we will know what to do next. For now we will change just one pill, and there will be no problem."
Swamishri said, somewhat moved, "We trouble you again and again."
As soon as he heard this, Ashwinbhai was choked with emotion and said, "Bapa! Where is the question of troubling? This is our duty. And you are giving us seva."
He could not say anything more. After coming out, he said to Yogicharan Swami, "Bapa is as innocent as a child."
Today, in the Youth Day assembly, the youths put before Mahant Swami Maharaj the questions that confuse them. Some of those questions are given here:
Question: "We are all like broken, battered boxes. Some are broken by lust, some by ego, some by body consciousness... So will you take us to Akshardham?"
"Yes, why not," Swamishri said.
Question: "Our minds get absorbed in the digital world, such as Facebook, WhatsApp and so on. Time is wasted in it, and if we don't use it, our companions think we are fools. So what should we do?"
Swamishri gave a wonderful answer: "If faith comes in the words of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, everything will drop away. Faith that 'only he can do me good, no one else.'"
Question: "Our mind is unsteady, so what should we do so that it becomes steady and does not wander?"

Giving the answer, Swamishri said, "That will happen while doing satsang. This is a very big thing. For births we have done just what we should not have done. Even becoming a graduate takes 20 years, so this will happen by keeping patience, keeping faith and keeping the company of the Sant. If you accept the words of the Sant, everything will come."
Question: "What should we do so that we keep a sense of divinity towards you and no sense of you as an ordinary human comes?"

Swamishri laughed and said, "You will have to practise. One day the sense of divinity will come, one day the human sense will come. Going on like this, knowledge will come; then the sense of divinity will remain forever."
